description: This file defines a DaysAdapter class for a RecyclerView in an Android weather app. It fetches weather data from an API endpoint, processes JSON responses to extract daily weather details, and binds this data to views for display. It manages view holders, updates UI components with weather info, and references external resources and classes for URL management and UI translation.

classes.name: DaysAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding daily weather data to recycler view items. Handles data fetching, JSON parsing, UI updates, and view holder management.

classes.name: DaysAdapter.DayViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to UI components within each day item in the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ViewHolder when needed, inflating the layout for a day item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds weather data to the ViewHolder for a specific position in the list.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items managed by the adapter, fixed at 6.

methods.name: getDailyWeatherInfo
methods.description: Fetches weather info from an API for a specific day index, parses JSON response, and updates UI components.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates UI components in the ViewHolder with weather data such as day, temperature, pressure, wind, humidity, and icon.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator and shows the weather info layout after data is loaded.
